title: Flying Blind: The 737 MAX Tragedy and the Fall of Boeing
author: Peter Robison
note: Selected for favorable reviews by technology historian Jon Gertner and financial journalist Roger Lowenstein, and Goodreads 4.17/4,503. Industrial governance and engineering reliability are central, with worldwide aviation consequences. American corporate setting and financial incentives do not make this primarily American-tragedy rhetoric or a finance book. Gertner's criticism of the MCAS explanation and David Gelles's criticism of length constrain the assessment. No serious veto established from these reviews; not treated as current technical safety guidance.
notes: Reported corporate history supported by interviews and records, with limits of retrospective attribution.

title: Mama's Last Hug: Animal Emotions and What They Tell Us about Ourselves
author: Frans de Waal
note: Selected for the favorable biologist review in The Inquisitive Biologist, corroborating critical reception, and Goodreads 4.21/5,844. Tom Chivers's reservations about some interpretations limit confidence, but the inspected criticism does not establish high-confidence foundational failure under V9. No health, spirituality or parenting advice veto.
